title: A Spring Day at the Zoo
setting: A zoo by a river, with a small farm corner.

characters.name: Grandpa Joe
characters.look: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

sentences.en: The sky is cloudy on a rainy spring morning.
sentences.zh: 春天的一个早晨，下着雨，天空多云。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grey clouds over a zoo with blossom trees; rain falls on Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) under one big umbrella.

sentences.zh: 乔爷爷还穿着他的冬衣。
